known_deviations.deviation: validated by a fixed depth-6 TypeExpr entry (the depth of a Constant body's root value's type arguments), because the type-argument list validator has no depth parameter; a FunctionRef constant rooted deeper (CapabilityRequirement scopes, TestCase inputs/observations/adapter configs/replay bindings) or nested under other constant nodes is charged from depth 6 instead of its native depth (root depth + 3 for a Constant, +1 per enclosing container path as the native codec charges)

known_deviations.deviation: entry key order is checked on the raw entry bytes before the entries are validated; the native decoder validates entry i before comparing keys, so a map whose earlier entry is malformed and whose later entry is misordered relative to it is refused by both codecs with different codes (native SCB_BOOL_INVALID for the first malformed entry, here SCB_MAP_ORDER)
known_deviations.direction: accepted set identical; refusal-code precedence differs in the double-fault case only
known_deviations.closure: validate entries before the order check
